scope: Visual comparison of three existing front candidates against the pinned secondary community front icons. Read-only review; six images actually inspected with view_image. No generation, raster editing, source registration or quantitative silhouette segmentation performed.
sourceType: Community PAYDAY2 port icon attributed to PHG, not a publisher-certified original PHG view
globalLimits: The 256-pixel references cannot establish exact micro-engravings, fine vent counts, original PHG palette/materials, UV fit or side/rear geometry.
Black background and dark material are not a clean shell alpha mask. This review does not infer an exact silhouette from RGB thresholds.

The long white dangling elements around Alpha and Vex have the same common arrangement in both icons. They are not established as intrinsic biomask geometry. Do not add them to a mask-only cutout merely to reproduce the whole wearer icon.
A proposed visual correction remains a candidate and requires comparison after generation; no existing asset should be overwritten or marked validated by this review.

macroFeaturesPreserved: Front camera; asymmetric radiating spike crest
Central dark bilobed forehead plate with a vertical seam
Layered cheek guards and two narrow eye apertures
Paired spiral reliefs around the lower central grille
uncertainties: Some thin crest tips and lower-grille lines differ in the enlarged reconstruction; the reference cannot establish an exact count or topology confidently.
Surface scratches, embossed edges and tiny perforations are reconstructed detail, not demonstrated exact PHG features.
reviews.recommendedAction: Retain as an explicitly secondary-reference candidate. No high-confidence macro error justifies another speculative redraw from this icon alone; obtain a larger primary front/mask-only reference before changing fine topology.

macroFeaturesPreserved: Bone/skull-like shell and two tall teardrop eye cavities
uncertainties: The candidate turns thumbnail-scale bone surface into very explicit pitting and ridge detail; that detail is not independently verified.
The white hanging common fringe overlaps lower mask forms in the reference, so the exact intrinsic fang count/length cannot be separated reliably. Do not prescribe a new count from this image.
The lower cavity proportions merit a better source, but the current thumbnail does not support a precise corrective measurement.
reviews.recommendedAction: Keep the mask-only scope and preserve the pinned reference. Do not add the shared wearer fringe. Obtain an unoccluded mask-only view before changing teeth, loop thickness or fine skull texture.

macroFeaturesPreserved: Broad dark domed forehead with a paired central channel
Two small dark rectangular brow vents and two slanted eye slits
Central vertical ridge down the lower face

assessableDifferences.observation: The reference lower face converges into a narrow, visibly pointed V. The candidate terminates in a broader rounded U/flat arc, reducing that sharp lower central point.
assessableDifferences.confidence: high for the broad contour, not for sub-pixel edge/topology
assessableDifferences.correctionScope: Reshape only the terminal lower central chin to the narrower pointed V of the reference. Preserve the dome, cheek guards, channel, apertures and front camera. Do not add the common white wearer fringe.

uncertainties: The bright reference eye region may include lighting or wearer effects. It does not prove that the isolated shell should receive emissive white eyes.
Extra fine seams, rivets and scratches are larger than what the 256-pixel source can establish.
reviews.recommendedAction: A tightly scoped ImageGen correction of the lower chin contour is defensible against the observed front reference. Compare the new candidate to both the current shell and the reference before admission; retain existing file as history.
